versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2 (botlearn-doctor)

Major update with new autonomous health check domains, shell-based data collection, and targeted diagnostics.

- Switched role from a manual diagnostic specialist to an autonomous health doctor.
- Added 5 deep health domains: hardware, config, security, skills, autonomy.
- Introduced 20+ dedicated data collection scripts (shell-based, parallel execution).
- Reports are now quantified per domain (0–100), with clear pass/warn/fail and actionable fix hints.
- User-facing output adapts to language, targets full or single domain checks, and no longer requires human-run commands.
- Simplified skill manifest, expanded and reorganized triggers, and removed legacy/manual files.

Initial release of the OpenClaw Health Diagnostic Specialist skill.

- Performs comprehensive health checks on the OpenClaw Agent environment.
- Collects, analyzes, and reports on environment, configuration, skills, logs, and workspace.
- Provides prioritized, actionable fix recommendations with clear safety and approval constraints.
- Supports automated and guided manual repairs, including backup, rollback, and before/after reporting.
- Ensures user privacy and safety with confirmation steps before any changes.
